vendors.name: Argentinian Grill
vendors.description: The Argentinian Grill has been bringing the flavours of Argentina to London since 2015. From the start, it has built a reputation for serving prime Argentine beef cooked to perfection over a traditional charcoal grill, creating steaks that are tender, juicy and full of flavour. Their homemade chimichurri is a point of pride, a family recipe that is both unique and unforgettable. Sourcing is central to everything they do. The team works closely with independent UK farmers to ensure quality meat and partners with local bakers for fresh, handmade breads and accompaniments. The menu is concise but carefully crafted, offering sirloin steaks, classic and spicy chorizo, and chicken wings spiced in-house alongside other meat-led dishes. Every plate reflects a passion for honest cooking, noble ingredients and the laid-back spirit of Argentine dining.

vendors.name: Badiani
vendors.description: Born in Florence in 1932, Badiani is one of the most prestigious gelato producers in the world. From its origins in the home of gelato, Badiani expanded to the UK in 2016 and now operates over ten stores across London and Brighton. In 2021, the brand opened new locations in Barcelona and Malaga as part of an ambitious expansion plan in the Iberian market. In 2024, Badiani opened in France within the world-famous Carrousel du Louvre. Badiani’s mission is to bring joy to consumers of all ages through the taste of historical artisan gelato, always made to the highest standards of quality and sustainability. The brand’s vision is to become the finest gelato brand in the world and inspire people with the flavour of freshly made artisan products

The family behind Bebek Baklava began their culinary journey generations ago, blending time-honoured Turkish recipes with a dedication to creating the finest Baklava. Each layer of phyllo dough is meticulously handcrafted, and every nut filling carefully selected, delivering a taste that reflects the heart of Turkey. Bebak offer more than indulgent treats; it is a place where heritage, rich aromas, and warm hospitality come together. Bebek Baklava invites visitors to experience its traditions, where every bite tells the story of quality, care, and a love for sharing history through food.

Guests can enjoy some of the finest German beers in a memorable setting at all German Kraft locations.

Founded by a female entrepreneur during the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic, the business grew from a small street food pop-up into an award-winning brand recognised at Mercato Metropolitano in 2022. The mission is to create delicious, healthy and easy-to-cook dumplings, known as momo, that bring a taste of the Himalayas into homes. Himalayan Dumpling is committed to empowering communities and championing female leadership, with sustainability and purpose guiding every decision, from ethical sourcing to reducing environmental impact. Each dumpling is a celebration of tradition, care and the joy of bringing people together over good food.

vendors.name: Karapincha
vendors.description: Karapincha celebrates real food grown from its roots. Founded by twin sisters from Sri Lanka, the concept brings their mother’s time-honoured recipes to life through a growing collection of authentic Sri Lankan cafés and kitchens. Raised in a household where every meal was made with love and layers of spice, they carry forward a rich culinary legacy that celebrates flavour, family and home. Born in Kandy and raised on the vibrant streets of Colombo, where their family owned one of the city’s most loved vegetarian restaurants, they grew up surrounded by homely dishes and the unmistakable aroma of hand-ground spices. These are the flavours that shaped them, and today they share them with new audiences every day.
